name: singlet_doublets_artifact_cluster_detection
title: Doublet artifact cluster detection
description: Labels each cluster of a fixed partition as real, doublet artifact or unclear, using per-cell doublet calls, the embedding and optional sample-barcode labels. Writes per-cluster calls, unique-gene rescue flags and the evidence tables used. The default method, composite, uses hashing evidence when hashing_key is set and expression evidence otherwise. Use after per-cell calling and clustering; do not use it to call individual barcodes or to choose clustering resolution.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

method.description: composite is the proposed default; doubletdecon_rescue and gmm_demux_phony are published criteria. gmm_demux_phony needs hashing_key.

cluster_key.description: obs column holding the fixed cluster partition to evaluate.

call_key.description: obs column of per-cell doublet calls from doublets.doublet_call_thresholding.

hashing_key.description: obs column of sample-barcode calls; enables the hashing channel and gmm_demux_phony.

composite.description: Options for the default composite method.

alpha.description: Significance level of the one-sided hashing binomial test; matches the GMM-Demux phony threshold.

tau_multiplet_fraction.description: Hashing-labelled multiplet fraction defining an artifact cluster; required when hashing_key is set. No literature default.

embedding_key.description: obsm key of the embedding used for segment distance to parent pairs.

exclusive_pairs.description: Pairs of mutually exclusive lineage genes; empty disables the exclusive-marker feature.

min_unique_genes.description: Unique genes a candidate cluster needs, against both parents, to be rescued as real.

rhop.description: Multiplier of the SD in the medoid-correlation blacklist cutoff.

phony_alpha.description: Significance level for the pure and phony labels, as in GMM-Demux.

confidence_threshold.description: Minimum posterior confidence for a hashing call, as in GMM-Demux.

ambiguous_rate.description: Chance that a phony droplet joins a pure cluster; the GMM-Demux command-line default.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate; queued: long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. obs/artifact_cluster_call. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Counts of real, artifact and unclear clusters, rescued clusters and the method used. Never per-cell data.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
